newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris blast likely of criminal origin - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Paris blast likely of criminal origin - ministry.

text.p: The French Interior Ministry said that the blast which killed two people and injured 28 at a station of the regional express underground railway in Paris on Tuesday was likely of criminal origin.
A spokesman for the ministry said the blast was "probably of criminal origin".
"There are apparently two dead," Prime Minister Alain Juppe told reporters before leaving his office for the scene of the blast.
The fire brigade said 28 people were injured, eight of them seriously in the blast below the junction of Boulevard Montparnasse and Boulevard Saint-Michel.

The explosion occurred on the same B line, and two stations away from Saint-Michel station where a blast in July last year killed eight people and injured nearly 100, launching a wave of attacks across France by Algerian Moslem fundamentalists.
